name: readout-scaling-placebo
cmd: set -e; for spec in desk_tempho_1995_s1:1996 desk_tempho_1985_s1:1986; do IFS=: read -r cc t0 <<< "$spec"; mkdir -p {out}/$cc; {python} research/exp/readout_scaling.py --cache {cache}/$cc --out {out}/$cc --t0 $t0; done
summarize: for d in {out}/*/; do {python} research/exp/readout_scaling.py --summarize $d | head -3; done
note: E033b: the split readout against a position x time placebo, DESK + placebo, and a continental-time-only block
